parameters.name: DateTime
parameters.description: Specify the date in the ISO 8601 standard. For example, 2023-01-01 represents January 1, 2023.

parameters.name: TableName
parameters.description: The table name. The table name must follow the rule in Hive. A name in the {database name.table identifier} format uniquely identifies a table.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun emr get-doctor-hive-table --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --cluster-id c-b933c5aac8fe0000 --date-time 2023-01-01 --table-name dw.dwd_creta_service_order_long_renew_long_da --region cn-hangzhou
